behavior: A root can ignore or cancel the open of a `beforematch` reveal, and `Collapsible.Panel` then reverts the reveal in a later frame. When `KeepAlive` holds the panel before that frame, the activation runs the revert. The revert writes `hidden="until-found"` and the `data-starting-style` that the reveal removed, and the next open keeps the motion of the author. Base UI under `Activity` writes `hidden="until-found"` again when it shows the panel and drops the other two, so its next open has no motion.
